diagnostics.metadata.title: Send diagnostics
diagnostics.metadata.description: Send the 6529 team a report of what the app did in the last few minutes, so they can help with a problem.
diagnostics.title: Send diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: If something went wrong, you can send the 6529 team a report of what the app did in the last 5 minutes. Nothing is sent until you choose Send. You then get a short code to give to the team.
diagnostics.preview.heading: What will be sent
diagnostics.preview.never: The report never includes messages you wrote, what you typed, wallet addresses, handles, full page addresses or sign-in tokens.
diagnostics.device.heading: This app
diagnostics.activity.heading: Recent activity
diagnostics.activity.empty: Nothing was recorded in the last 5 minutes.
diagnostics.previous.heading: Before the last reload
diagnostics.screenshot.label: Attach a screenshot
diagnostics.screenshot.hint: Off unless you turn it on. Your browser asks which tab, window or screen to capture, and only that one picture is attached.
diagnostics.screenshot.alt: Screenshot that will be attached to the report
diagnostics.sent.heading: Report sent
diagnostics.sent.instructions: Give this code to the 6529 team. The report is deleted after 14 days.
diagnostics.error.too_large: The report is too large to send. Remove the screenshot and try again.
diagnostics.error.rate_limited: Too many reports were sent from this connection. Try again in an hour.
diagnostics.error.unavailable: Reports can't be received right now. Try again later.
diagnostics.error.offline: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
diagnostics.error.failed: The report couldn't be sent. Try again.
diagnostics.crash.heading: Send the team a report?
diagnostics.crash.text: You can send the 6529 team a report of what the app did just before this happened. You see exactly what it contains first, and nothing is sent unless you choose Send.
